quote.text: This isn't procrastination and to-do lists make it worse

promise.text: Executive dysfunction vs procrastination: the difference

lines.text: They can look identical from outside, and they can overlap.
How to tell which one you're in today, and what lowers the cost of starting.

eyebrow.text: Five questions to ask yourself about today

head.text: Is there something you'd rather be doing?

body.text: If you're doing nothing, or something you don't enjoy, starting itself may be the wall.

eyebrow.text: Five questions to ask yourself about today

head.text: Could you say the first physical action out loud, such as open the form or find the account number?

body.text: If you can't, the task hasn't been broken down yet.

eyebrow.text: Five questions to ask yourself about today

head.text: Would a deadline in an hour get you moving?

body.text: If it would, delay is more likely.
If you'd sit there looking at it anyway, more pressure probably isn't the missing piece.

eyebrow.text: Five questions to ask yourself about today

head.text: Is it one task, or a pile?

eyebrow.text: Five questions to ask yourself about today

head.text: Are you also short on sleep, ill, grieving or flat?

body.text: Those change how much capacity you have on any given day, and a smaller first step is a fair response to all of them.

line.text: One thing at a time, chosen for you from what you already said mattered, and a plain "nothing needs you" on the days that is true.
